EmailTemplate.subject: WX TAX - Non-filing Return Notice
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Insperity Payroll Services 19001 Crescent Springs Drive Kingwood, Texas 77339
{!MONTH(TODAY())}/{!DAY(TODAY())}/{!YEAR(TODAY())}
Name of Agency Agency Department Name Mailing Address City, State Zip Code
RE: {!Case.Account} {!Account.NSP_FEIN__c} {!Account.AccountNumber} Notice Number
Dear Sir or Madam,
Our client received the attached failure to file notice. We assumed the tax filing responsibility for our client as of first check date. I have carefully reviewed the information provided in this notice.
Our records indicate that the tax return was submitted on date. I have enclosed a copy of the return for your reference.
OR
Our records confirm that the tax return was not filed due to a delay in the client receiving their account number. This was not due to a malicious intent or willful neglect of compliance. The completed return is attached.
If you need additional assistance in this matter or have any questions, I can be reached at or IPS.TAX@Insperity.com.
Many thanks for your attention to this matter.
Regards,
